author: kindofaproducer
body:
Sauzo’s on Beach had some great food and the best mushroom taco I’ve tried in the area. It’s just a little out of the way.

Primecut just opened at Center Street Promenade. It’s basically a Los Cholos dupe, but without the line.

I think the food at El Nopal is good.

The Taco Shop has great $2 tacos.

Mi Casa’s food is pretty good.
